text: Femi lives in Walthamstow now, just off the high street. Works for the council in planning.
Siobhan's puppy arrived on Saturday, a cocker spaniel called Biscuit. She's already exhausted from getting up with him at 3am.
Tobi graduates from Leeds on 14 July. His parents are flying in from Lagos the day before and they're all going out for dinner afterwards. I should send him a card so it arrives that morning.
Ryan's cat Pepper had three teeth out on Tuesday. She was very groggy the next day but she's eating again now.
Emil and Salma have been together six years. They live in the flat above the bakery on Mill Road.
Nia's daughter starts reception on 3rd September. Nia is far more nervous about it than the little one is. Remind me to message her that evening to see how it went.
Jada mentioned that her brother Marcus works as a paramedic in Bristol.
Vera's dog Rolo turns ten on 22/11. She's planning a little party for him in the garden, which is very Vera. She also said she'd love a framed print of him one day.
Need to pick up the dry cleaning before Friday and book the car in for its MOT.
Yasmin's son Haruto has his GCSE maths exam on 12 June. He's been really anxious and isn't sleeping well. Don't forget to text him good luck the night before.
Mila said her graduation ceremony has been moved to the 28th of June because of the strikes. Her grandparents are coming over from Kraków for it.

Erin is a vet nurse at the practice on Elm Street. She has two rescue greyhounds and lives with her partner Tadhg in Hove. He's a carpenter and does a lot of the work on their house himself, which is why it's been half finished for about three years.
Chantal's hamster died last week. Her kids took it really hard, especially the youngest. I should check in with her at the weekend.
Lwazi passed his driving test! First try, which nobody expected. Must send congrats.
Laila's mum is from Beirut originally but has lived in Manchester for thirty years.
Keisha said Milan finishes nursery on 18 July and there's a little leavers' assembly that morning. She'd love me to come along, so I'm going.
Yusuf adopted a kitten from the shelter on 2 October and named her Saffron. He's thinking about getting a second one so she has company.

Long call with Laura tonight. Her eldest, Olivia, got her A-level results on 15 August and got into Edinburgh to study medicine, which is huge given how much she struggled with chemistry last year. They're driving her up on 14th September and Laura is already dreading the drive back alone the next day, because her husband can't get the time off work. Remind me to send Olivia a card before she leaves and to ring Laura the weekend after they drop her off.
Mateo works nights at the hospital, so never ring him before two.
Yuki's graduation party was cancelled because her dad is in hospital. He had a fall on 9 May and broke his hip. Need to find out how he's doing.
Bethany has a new puppy, a little Labrador called Bramble. Her landlord doesn't know yet.
Jasmine mentioned her nephew starts secondary school next week. She's bought him far too much stationery.

Emeka and Efua are moving into their first house on 30/10. The removal van comes that morning, and they've got family arriving the day after to help unpack. Efua is pretty stressed because the sale nearly fell through twice and they still haven't seen the boiler working. Emeka seems to think it'll all be fine.
Suzanne's parrot, Captain, is apparently forty years old and has outlived two of her husbands. She lives in the cottage at the end of Bell Lane.
Dentist on 4 Nov at 9:15. Cancel the gym session that day.
Dr Kumar said Grandad's results will be back on 7th December. Mum wants me at the appointment, so I'm driving her down the day before.
Salma's cat Mochi has gone missing, last seen on Sunday evening. She's put posters up all round the estate. I should share her post on the neighbourhood group.
Jada has her grade 8 piano exam on 21 March and she's convinced she'll fail it. Her teacher, Mrs Moreau, says she's more than ready.
Emil's daughter took her first steps yesterday! He sent a very wobbly video.

Nia works as a solicitor at a firm in Canary Wharf. Her wife is a primary school teacher. They have twin boys, both about seven, and live in a terrace in Lewisham that they've been extending for what feels like forever.
Marcus Santos, "Big Marc" to everyone at work, is retiring on 31 January. There's a do at the Crown that evening. Must get a card for the team to sign the week before.
Siobhan's dog Juno had surgery on her leg on 2nd October. Siobhan stayed off work the next day to look after her. Text her to ask how Juno is getting on.
Haruto starts at university in Sheffield on 21 September. His mum is struggling with the idea of an empty house.
Erin says Tadhg would love a new fishing rod. His birthday is on 5 March.
Vera's grandson graduated from Durham on 12 July. She showed me about forty photos of him in the gown.
Keisha lives in the flat downstairs from her sister Chantal. Their mum is two streets away.
Laila's son has his eleven-plus on 14/09. She's taking him out for pizza afterwards whatever happens. Remind me to message her that afternoon.
Mila and her husband are getting a puppy in a fortnight. They've been on the waiting list for nearly a year.
Yusuf's daughter Yasmin had her PhD viva on Monday and passed with minor corrections. He's so proud. Send her a congratulations message.

Femi's dad turns eighty on the 3rd of June. Femi is organising a surprise lunch at his aunt's house and has asked me to bring the cake that morning. His dad apparently hates fuss, so it's a bit of a gamble. Femi's sister is flying in from Accra the day before and staying for a week afterwards.
Need to renew my passport before the end of the month.
Bethany's son, Milan, was really nervous before his first day at secondary school on 4 September. Remember to ask her how his first few weeks have gone.
Olivia Gonzalez from book club teaches Spanish at the sixth form college. She lives in Clifton with her two cats.
Lwazi's tortoise is hibernating in a box in the garage until March. He checks on it every single morning.

Ryan said his mum's knee operation on 10/10 went well. She's home now and his sister is staying with her for a week afterwards. He sounded relieved, though he's worried she'll try to do too much too soon, because she's already talking about getting back to her allotment.
Tadhg's niece Nia graduates in nursing on 2 December. He's going over to Cork the day before for it.

Bumped into Suzanne at the school gates. Her youngest, Mateo, has been having a hard time since moving up to Year 3 and she thinks he might be being picked on. She has a meeting with his teacher on 6 November and was clearly anxious about it. Her husband is working away in Aberdeen until Christmas, so she's doing it all on her own. I should drop round the day after the meeting and see how she's doing.
Yuki said her cat is seventeen now and mostly deaf, but still yells for breakfast at 5am.
Chantal's twins sit their SATs the week of 11 May. She's more stressed about it than they are.
Emeka is an engineer at Rolls-Royce in Derby. His wife Efua runs a small catering business.
Jasmine's rabbit, Clover, has her first birthday on the 1st of April. Jasmine has ordered a tiny cake. Must remember to send her a silly card.

Lots going on for Marcus. His son Tobi graduates on 19 July, then the family go to Portugal on the 25th for two weeks, and the week after they get back Tobi starts his graduate job in Birmingham. Marcus is a bit overwhelmed but excited. Don't forget to ask Marcus how the ceremony went.
Haven't decided about the Lake District trip yet. I'll check dates with work first.
Laura's dog Pip had to be put down on Thursday. She was in pieces. Must send her flowers tomorrow.
Efua Le is the new neighbour at number 12. She moved here from Leicester with her son and a very loud beagle.
Siobhan Morris, Shiv, from my old job is now head of HR at the hospital trust.
Vera's daughter hands in her dissertation on 8 May and graduates on 14/07. Vera has already bought a hat for the ceremony.

Salma said Emil gets anxious at big family gatherings, so they're keeping the christening on 23 November small. Their baby, Ada, is four months old and already has more cardigans than I do. Salma's parents are coming down from Glasgow the weekend before to help get the house ready.
Mateo Yilmaz texted to say the puppy he took in has parvo. The vet is keeping her in overnight and he'll know more the next morning. I should ring him tomorrow afternoon.
Picked Emeka and Efua's kids up from school today. Their eldest has decided she wants to be an astronaut, and she has a grade 3 piano exam next month.
